args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy (error rate 0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback to v2.3.0.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` is now **healthy** (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

Note: v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production, so this rollback did not require change-manager approval.
